entities.summary: Johann Niklaus Schneider, colloquially Johann Schneider-Ammann, is a Swiss businessman, electrical engineer and politician who most notably served as President of Switzerland in 2016, and concurrently as a member of the Federal Council (Switzerland) for The Liberals.
